title: feat(app-shell): Studio customizes an installed app's navigation into its customization package (#30059)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB4zJHeAmyfVthL884t1sTB1)_

Fixes #30059

## 维护者速读
- **改了什么**：已安装（只读）包有 `.custom` 配对包时，Studio「界面」导轨可以编辑应用导航；首次保存把整个应用复制进配对包并声明 `overrides: { package, basedOn }`，选择器列出配对包里的对象/页面/仪表板等，导轨显示「已定制」标记、计入「仅看定制」，并可「恢复原版」。
- **为什么改**：配对包里新建的对象此前无法进菜单，只能手敲 URL 访问。
- **风险与回滚**：仅 `@object-ui/app-shell` 前端；无 spec、服务端、元数据类型改动；可写包的导航编辑不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。已定制的应用是整份副本，厂商后续版本新增的菜单项要恢复原版后重做才会出现。
- **先看**：`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 的 `doNavSave`（首存复制进配对包）和 `StudioNavItemInspector.tsx` 的 `gatePatch`（配对包对象的菜单项自动带 `requiresObject`）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/InterfacesPillar.customize-28562.test.tsx -t 30059`（6 条全绿）。
- **需要你做的**：评审并在合适时合并；无其他操作。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

On a read-only base package (installed or code-shipped) that has, or can get, its paired customization package `<base>.custom` (ADR-0146 D3), the Interfaces rail now edits the app's navigation through the same route a view's Customize takes. Card Scope 1–5 all ship in this PR (diff ≈ 670 lines, under the 1,500 split line).

1. **First save copies the whole app into the pair.** Edit and the "+" open the existing navigation editor (`addNavEntry`, `StudioNavItemInspector`, reused). Opening Edit writes nothing. The first saved edit asks the ensure door for the pair, then writes the whole app there as a draft with `overrides: { package: <base>, basedOn: <base manifest.version> }` (`overrideDraftBody`, `_` keys stripped), pinned `ifNoneMatch: '*'`. Later edits update that copy; the base package is never written.
2. **Pickers list the pair's items.** The object picker (the pillar's object list) and the page / dashboard / report / view / doc pickers (`usePackageNavTargets`) read the pair after the base, the base winning on a name clash.
3. **Missing-object guard.** An entry bound to an object only the pair holds carries `requiresObject: <object>`, so the runtime hides it if that object is removed instead of linking to "object not found". A gate this binding wrote is removed when the entry is rebound to a base object or unbound; an author's own gate is kept. (`requiresObject` is an existing spec key the console already evaluates; no spec change.)
4. **One batch.** The navigation change is a draft in the pair's pending changes and publishes with the object it opens through the pair's existing `publish-drafts` (measured below).
5. **Rail mark, count, restore.** When the pair serves the app (its draft or its published copy), the rail header carries the compact "customized" `CustomizationMark` (no text label), "only customizations" counts it and keeps the navigation listed, and the mark's popover names the base and version and offers "Restore package original", which asks for confirmation and then deletes the pair's draft and copy of the app.

A walled caller (no pair, no right to create one) is offered neither Edit nor the "+", and neither is a caller on a base whose manifest declares no version (no override can be declared then, so every save of the copy would be refused). `StudioCustomizeControls.tsx` changes only its types list (`app` added) and docblock. No spec, server, metadata-type, `app_extension` or upgrade-merge change.

## Tests

`InterfacesPillar.customize-28562.test.tsx`, new describe "Customize a read-only base’s navigation into its pair (objectstack#30059)", 6 tests:
- Edit writes nothing; the first saved edit copies the whole app into the pair with the declaration (body pinned with `toStrictEqual`), `ifNoneMatch: '*'`; the base row is untouched; the mark's facts read back.
- The pickers offer the pair's object and dashboard; the entry bound to the pair's object is saved into the pair with `requiresObject`; rebound to a base object it carries no gate.
- The mark and a count of 1 under "only customizations", which keeps the tree.
- Restore: Cancel deletes nothing; Confirm deletes the pair's draft, then its row, and the shipped navigation reads back.
- A walled caller sees no Edit and no "+".
- CONTROL: on a writable package the navigation saves at the package, with no door and no declaration.

`StudioCustomizeControls.customize-28562.test.tsx`: `app` moves to the customized types.

`StudioDesignSurface.oneSurface-28572.test.tsx`: one existing pin changes on purpose. It said the "+" on a read-only base offers no navigation entry; it now says it does, and that creating an item still links none. `navEditClosesOnReadOnly-11167` stays unchanged and green: its base declares no version, so a read-only answer still closes nav editing there.

Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the pre-mutation blob):
- Drop `'app'` from `STUDIO_CUSTOMIZE_TYPES` → 4 failed / 2 passed (the CONTROL stays green).
- Skip the declaration (`saved = declared` → `saved = { ...saved }`) → 2 failed / 4 passed.
- Return no gate for a pair object (`gateFor`, since renamed `gatePatch`) → 1 failed / 5 passed.
- The version rule has no ablation run of its own. Before it was added, the 197-file sweep showed `navEditClosesOnReadOnly-11167` red on 2 tests; with the rule they pass.

## Acceptance notes

Dev boot of `examples/app-crm` (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`) with the console on Vite; `com.example.crm` 4.0.0 is read-only (`writable: false`). The run was on `6f468077`. The last commit changes nothing it exercised: the base has a version, and a pair-object binding writes the same gate. Screenshots are in the project's `ui-orders/30059-shots/` folder; file names below.

1. **New object → menu → one batch → visible as a user.** Created 合同 (`crm_custom_contract`) in the Data pillar: the ensure door answered 201 and created `com.example.crm.custom` (`02-object-in-pair.png`). In Interfaces, the "+" → Object added an entry; the picker listed `合同 (crm_custom_contract)` after the base's objects (`03-picker-lists-pair-object.png`); the rail showed the mark and "saved to CRM (minimal example)'s customization" (`04-entry-added-marked.png`). The first save's body was the whole app (both groups, all six shipped entries, the dashboard entry's CEL `visible`) with `overrides: {package: "com.example.crm", basedOn: "4.0.0"}`. Pending changes listed object (new) + app (update) in the pair, "publishes all 2 drafts at once" (`05-pending-changes-one-batch.png`); `POST /packages/com.example.crm.custom/publish-drafts` answered `publishedCount: 2`, `published: [object crm_custom_contract, app crm_app]`, one `commitId`. Repeated with a second object (发票) for the screenshot: same shape, `publishedCount: 2`, one commit. The runtime sidebar then listed 合同 → `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_custom_contract` (`06-runtime-admin-sees-contract.png`).
2. **Restore.** The mark's popover reads "replaces the item of the same name in CRM (minimal example), taken from 4.0.0" (`13-mark-popover-restore.png`); Restore asks first (`14-restore-confirm.png`), then sent `DELETE …?state=draft&package=com.example.crm.custom` and `DELETE …?package=com.example.crm.custom` (both 200). The rail lost the mark and showed the shipped navigation (`15-restored-shipped-nav.png`), the runtime sidebar the shipped six entries (`16-restored-runtime-nav.png`), and `GET /meta/app/crm_app?layers=true` answered `overlay: null`, `effective == code`, with the base `code` hashing the same before and after.
3. **A member who can't read the object.** An invited `member` (no CRM object permissions) gets 403 on `/data/crm_custom_contract` and `/data/crm_lead`. Their sidebar shows none of those entries, including 合同 (`07-runtime-member-no-read.png`), and the typed URL shows "no access" (`08-member-opens-contract.png`). Limit: this member reads none of the CRM objects, so it shows the pair's entry treated like the shipped ones, not a member who reads the base's objects but not the pair's.
4. **Removing the object.** Before the gate, deleting `crm_custom_contract` left the runtime entry linking to "object 'crm_custom_contract' does not exist" (`09-before-gate-object-removed-dead-link.png`, `10-before-gate-studio-rail.png`). That is why Scope item 3 above was added. With the gate written by the picker, the entry shows while the object exists (`17-gated-entry-object-present.png`) and is hidden after it is deleted (`18-object-removed-entry-hidden.png`). The Studio rail still lists it, so the author can remove it.

Observed, not changed: the pending-changes row and the Restore dialog name the app by its raw label "CRM" while the rail shows the translated "客户管理".

## Verification

All under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` unless noted. Head `6e106af3` (main merged after #30113 landed).

- Build: `turbo run build` for `@object-ui/app-shell...`, 119/119 tasks.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` (both tsconfigs) → exit 0, before and after merging main.
- Tests: every app-shell test file importing `StudioDesignSurface`, `StudioNavItemInspector`, `InterfacesNavRail` or `StudioCustomizeControls`: 197 files, 1359 tests, all passed. The first sweep found 3 red files, fixed in `bee40cbe` (see Tests). After the merge, the 8 files the merge and this PR share: 180 passed.
- `npx eslint` on the 6 touched source/test files (unlocked): 0 errors, 58 warnings.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` → exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 35 commands, all recorded `:: exit 0`; `--ran` → "35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". One run was red at first: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` had 2 tests time out at 15 s while the 197-file sweep shared the box. Those 2 files then passed alone, and the whole command passed on rerun (170 files, exit 0). That rerun's exit is the recorded one.
- Changed lines vs the human-merge threshold: 677 (+593 / −84, 8 files), under 3,000.
